prompt:
Document type: adjuster_file. Page 1 of 2.

<page>
Harbor Point Mutual Auto Insurance
Bodily Injury Unit
Claim Notes
Claim number:
C-1288
Claimant:
Gregory Martinez
Adjuster:
Darin Tyler
March 23, 2023
Claim received for a parking lot collision with a knee injury reported by the claimant, who is not represented by an
attorney. Initial contact made and claim file opened for review.
April 1, 2023
Reviewed the police report and spoke with two witnesses, who both confirm the vehicles made contact in the parking
lot as the claimant described. Photos taken at the scene are on file.
April 25, 2023
Spoke with the other driver, whose account of the impact matches the claimant's description. The damage shown in
the photos lines up with the reported point of impact.
June 10, 2023
Confirmed the driver involved is named on the policy and that the policy was in force on the date of loss. Nothing in
the file suggests the vehcile damage predates coverage.
June 30, 2023
Claimant described the knee injury and how it happened during a recorded call. The account was consistent with the
police report and the witness statements already on file.
August 19, 2023
Reviewed the vehicle appraisal. The damage pattern fits the impact described, and no earlier damage to the vehicle
appears in our records or in the inspection notes.
September 2, 2023
Obtained medical records showing the knee ijnury is a plausible result of a collision of this type. No prior injury to the
same knee or area appears in the claimant's history.
September 17, 2023
Treatment followed a typical course, with pain and mobility improving steadily, and the provider noted that care is
tapering as recovery progresses. Claimant has given the same account of events in every conversatoin so far.
September 25, 2023
Reviewed the file as a whole. Witnesses, photos, the other driver, and the police report all support the accident as
described, and the claimant's presence in the vehicle is confirmed. Claim is progressing through standard evaluation.
</page>

Rate each feature below that THIS page gives evidence about. Leave out a feature the page
says nothing about. The ratings are listed from least to most suspicious.
- injury_crash_fit: Does the claimed injury fit the type and force of the crash? Allowed: Strong, Reasonable, Unclear, Inconsistent.
- treatment_growth: Did the treatment grow beyond what this injury needs? Allowed: Normal, Elevated, Disproportionate, Extreme.
- pre_existing_condition: Did an earlier condition of the same body area add to the complaints? Allowed: None, Minor, Material, Predominant.
- occurrence_support: Do independent sources (witnesses, photos, cameras, the other driver) confirm that the accident happened as described? Allowed: Confirmed, Partially corroborated, Uncorroborated, Contradicted, Suspected staged.
- damage_crash_fit: Does the vehicle damage fit the described impact? Allowed: Strong, Reasonable, Unclear, Inconsistent.
- account_stability: Did the claimant's account of the accident stay the same over time? Allowed: Stable, Clarified, Materially changed.
- occupant_presence: Was the claimant really in the vehicle at the time of the crash? Allowed: Verified, Unclear, Added later, Not present.
- prior_damage_evidence: Is there evidence of vehicle damage from before this crash? Allowed: None, Possible, Documented, Material.
- known_loss_evidence: Is there evidence the damage existed or was known before the coverage started? Allowed: Weak, Moderate, Strong.
- driver_status: Is the driver of the insured vehicle on the policy? Allowed: Listed, Household, Unlisted, Excluded.

For each rated feature give:
- "rating": exactly one of the allowed ratings,
- "confidence": "High", "Medium" or "Low" (how clearly the page shows it),
- "quote": one or two sentences copied EXACTLY from the page that support the rating, with any
  spelling errors as they are,
- "reason": one short sentence.
JSON format:
